name: Internal support assistant
description: The session 3/4 system, used by Velora's own support team. Every answer is read by a member of staff before it reaches a customer, which is what makes the escalation rate the dominant cost term rather than the inference.

name: Customer-facing chat
description: The answer IS the product: the customer reads it unedited. Volume is 20x the internal tool and the human-review fraction is the decision variable, not a given.
